caps: There is *ONE* weapon | you beat by *DROPPING* yours.
Fight it, even in your *MIND,* | and it *KILLS* you.
lines.tts: There is one weapon you beat, by dropping yours. Fight it, even in your mind, and it kills you.

caps: Kurukshetra, day 15. | *DRONA* is killed by a lie.
lines.tts: Kurukshetra, day fifteen. Drona is killed, by a lie.

caps: and calls the weapon his father got | from *NARAYANA* himself.
lines.tts: His son Ashwatthaamaa wipes his tears, and calls the weapon his father got from Naaraayana himself.
The earth shook. The sea churned. Rivers flowed backwards.

caps: *THOUSANDS* of blazing arrows, | iron balls, razor-edged discs.
lines.tts: Then the sky filled. Thousands of blazing arrows, iron balls, razor-edged discs.
The Paandavas fought back, and every strike made it stronger.

caps: Then *KRISHNA* held the army back | with his arms:
“Drop your weapons. | Get down to the ground.
Whoever fights it, | even in his *MIND,* it will kill.”
lines.tts: Then Krishna held the army back with his arms. Drop your weapons! Get down to the ground. Whoever fights it, even in his mind, it will kill.

caps: And a whole army | let its weapons fall.
lines.tts: And a whole army, let its weapons fall.
All but one. Bheema. I have the strength of ten thousand elephants. I will fight it!

caps: The whole weapon | fell on *HIS* head.
lines.tts: The whole weapon fell on his head.

caps: They dragged Bhima off his chariot | and threw him to the ground.
lines.tts: Krishna and Arjuna ran into the fire, unarmed. They dragged Bheema off his chariot, and threw him to the ground.

caps: The moment his weapons | touched the earth,
lines.tts: The moment his weapons touched the earth, the Naaraayanaastra went silent.
Naaraayana's own weapon, stopped by Naaraayana himself.

caps: “It can't be used twice. | It would kill *ME.*”
lines.tts: Duryodhana begged: use it again! It can't be used twice. It would kill me.

caps: So tell us: | *BHIMA,* brave or foolish?
lines.tts: So tell us. Bheema, brave, or foolish?

caps: came the night | he became a killer.
lines.tts: And Ashwatthaamaa? Three days later came the night he became a killer. Read it in our comic.
